definitions.gloss: good deed; virtuous act; good conduct
definitions.explanation: A morally commendable action or behavior.

examples.japanese: {善行|ぜんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日|ひ}ごろ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{善行|ぜんこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: He is known for his good deeds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{見返|みかえ}り→見返り：11064_mikaeri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{求|もと}めない→求める：02316_motomeru⟧{善行|ぜんこう}⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{優|やさ}しさだ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I think that good deeds done without expecting anything in return are true kindness.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{善|ぜん}→善：00465_zen⟧ (good, virtuous) + {行|こう} (conduct, deed). Refers to morally praiseworthy actions, often used in contexts related to ethics, religion, and character evaluation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {善行|ぜんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積|つ}む→積む：02294_tsumu⟧: to accumulate good deeds
- {善行|ぜんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to perform good deeds
- {善行|ぜんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{施|ほどこ}す→施す：12985_hodokosu⟧: to bestow good deeds
- ⟦{日々|ひび}→日々：04804_hibi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{善行|ぜんこう}: daily acts of virtue

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {善|よ}いこと: a good thing — everyday, casual expression; {善行|ぜんこう} is more formal and elevated
- ⟦{親切|しんせつ}→親切：01144_shinsetsu⟧: kindness — describes the quality of being kind; {善行|ぜんこう} describes the action itself
- {功徳|くどく}: merit (Buddhist) — specifically religious merit from good actions; {善行|ぜんこう} is broader
- ⟦{悪行|あくぎょう}→悪行：23069_akugyou⟧: evil deed — the opposite of {善行|ぜんこう}

REGISTER:
Somewhat formal and literary. Often appears in moral, religious, or philosophical discussions.
